headline: Trump's pressure on PM Modi! Kejriwal announces march over E20, says he will go to PM residence tomorrow with 100 people
summary: Arvind Kejriwal announced a march to submit a petition with over 2 lakh signatures against E20 petrol. He accused the Modi government of yielding to Trump's pressure to buy US ethanol.
why: Ethanol blending mandates and imports affect India's fuel supply, refiners and agricultural producers, and they are part of the trade relationship with the United States.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude
